title: CalculationRequest
description:
The shared JSON/MCP request: civil fields plus optional `extensions`.

Civil fields retain their original flat JSON layout. Rust stores them in the
independent calendar request, avoiding a second copy of its validation rules.
Unknown civil fields, extension names, and rule values are rejected.

day.description: Gregorian day, validated against the month and year.

extensions.description: Optional annotations, all disabled when omitted or empty.

second.description: Local civil second, 0–59; leap seconds are not accepted.

utc_offset_minutes.description:
Fixed offset east of UTC, in minutes, from −840 through +840.
Supply the offset actually applicable at the requested date, including DST.

DayBoundary.description: Civil-clock convention for the day pillar.

oneOf.description: Change the day pillar at 23:00, at the start of 子时.

Change the day pillar at 00:00. The 23:00 子 hour still uses the following
day's stem for its hour pillar, preserving one pillar across 子时.

申子辰→寅、寅午戌→申、亥卯未→巳、巳酉丑→亥, using the
calculated day pillar and therefore the request's day-boundary rule.
Door element controls palace element; the reverse is not 门迫.

ExtensionOptions.description:
The optional annotations to calculate after constructing a base chart.

Every field defaults to disabled. Each selected rule is copied into the
output, so a caller can distinguish school conventions from chart facts.

day_horse.description: Day-pillar travelling horse, independent of the base chart's hour horse.

door_pressure.description: 门迫: a door's element controls its destination palace's element.

growth_stages.description: 十二长生 for every stem and every branch in its palace.

hidden_stems.description: 暗干: fly the hour stem from the duty-door palace.

punishments.description: 六仪击刑, preserving heavenly/earthly and hosted-stem identities.

strength.description: 星、门、干旺衰, evaluated against both the palace and solar month.

tombs.description: 天干入墓 under the explicitly selected convention.

oneOf.description:
Yang stems progress forward, yin stems backward; 戊 follows 丙 and
己 follows 丁. Every branch in a double-branch palace remains separate.

Put the hour stem at the duty door, then fly the nine instruments in
numeric palace order (yang forward, yin backward). If it repeats that
palace's earth stem, start at palace five. 甲 uses its hidden instrument.

Stars use 生我为废、我生为旺、同我为相、我克为休、克我为囚.
Doors/stems use ordinary 旺相休囚死. Both evaluate the palace element
and the element of the solar-month pillar's branch (not lunar month).

TombRule.description: Supported stem-tomb conventions; these must not be conflated.

oneOf.description:
Use 墓 in the yang-forward/yin-reverse twelve stages, with earth
following fire. In this convention 乙's tomb is 戌, not 未.

Classical 三奇入墓 only: 乙→未、丙→戌、丁→丑. Other stems
are explicitly not applicable; this does not supply a six-instrument rule.
